paragraphs.随着智慧家居与家庭安防系统持续演进，家庭入口场景已由传统可视对讲扩展为集身份核验: With the continuous evolution of smart homes and home security systems, the home entrance scenario has expanded from traditional video intercom to a composite application scenario integrating identity verification, event traceability, and remote intervention. Delivery personnel, food delivery workers, property staff, and temporary visitors are characterized by high frequency, short stays, and strong randomness. Without traceable event records and timely handling mechanisms, risks such as abnormal loitering and tailgating entry will be difficult to identify in time and audit afterwards [10][11].
paragraphs.与室内固定场景相比，门口场景具有短时交互、光照变化显著、遮挡与逆光频发以及设备算: Compared with indoor fixed scenes, the doorstep scenario features short-time interaction, significant illumination changes, frequent occlusion and backlight, and constrained device computing power. Therefore, system design must simultaneously meet multiple requirements including second-level response, robust recognition, privacy protection, and long-term stable operation [9][12].
paragraphs.近年来云边端协同与边缘智能的发展，使树莓派等低成本嵌入式平台具备部署轻量级视觉模: In recent years, the development of cloud-edge-device collaboration and edge intelligence has made it feasible to deploy lightweight visual models on low-cost embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi. In the field of face recognition, the pipeline of detection, feature representation learning, and vector comparison has become relatively mature, with lightweight networks, model compression, and inference optimization becoming key technical routes for deployment on resource-constrained devices [6][8][13].
paragraphs.然而，仅依赖端侧离线处理难以满足多终端查看、集中存储和远程处置需求。因此，面向家: However, relying solely on device-side offline processing makes it difficult to meet the demands of multi-terminal viewing, centralized storage, and remote handling. Therefore, smart doorbells for home security typically adopt a cloud-edge collaborative architecture: the edge side completes real-time sensing and preliminary decision-making, the cloud is responsible for structured event management, command scheduling, and auditing, while the mobile side handles status display and high-risk operation interaction, thereby achieving a balance among real-time performance, availability, and traceability [12].
paragraphs.基于上述背景，本文设计并实现一套以树莓派为边缘节点、云端服务为管理中心、Andr: Based on the above background, this paper designs and implements a smart doorbell and visitor management system with the Raspberry Pi as the edge node, cloud services as the management center, and an Android client as the interaction portal. The system provides identity verification and unlock linkage for family members, snapshot recording and anomaly alerting for strangers, and enhances the manageability and controllability of the home entrance scenario through remote control closed-loop and security audit mechanisms.
paragraphs.现有智能门铃与家庭安防系统普遍以视频采集、事件检测和移动端提醒为基础能力，并逐步: Existing smart doorbells and home security systems generally take video capture, event detection, and mobile notification as basic capabilities, and gradually introduce advanced functions such as target recognition, abnormal behavior analysis, and cloud evidence storage [10]. Among these, cloud-centralized solutions facilitate unified model training, policy updates, and cross-device management, but are more sensitive to bandwidth, latency, and service availability, and are prone to problems such as alert lag and unstable control links under network jitter conditions.
paragraphs.从体系结构看，相关研究主要形成两类技术路线：一类是以云端智能为主的集中式方案，将: From an architectural perspective, related research has mainly formed two technical routes: one is a centralized approach dominated by cloud intelligence, uploading recognition, analysis, and storage tasks to the cloud; the other is a distributed approach dominated by edge intelligence, completing real-time inference on the device side and only uploading structured events or evidence summaries to the cloud [9]. The latter has advantages in latency control, privacy protection, and weak-network availability, but imposes higher requirements on device-side model lightweighting, resource scheduling, and system stability.
paragraphs.此外，家庭入口场景同时包含家庭成员、快递员、外卖员、物业人员及临时访客等多类主体: Furthermore, the home entrance scenario simultaneously involves multiple types of subjects including family members, couriers, food delivery workers, property staff, and temporary visitors. The system must not only improve recognition pass rates but also control false admission rates and false alarm rates. Therefore, research focus has expanded from single recognition accuracy to system-level capabilities such as threshold strategies, anomaly handling, event tracking, audit trails, and operational observability.
paragraphs.人脸识别通常包含人脸检测、对齐、特征表示学习与相似度判别等环节，当前基于深度特征: Face recognition typically includes stages such as face detection, alignment, feature representation learning, and similarity discrimination. Currently, vector comparison based on deep feature embedding has become the mainstream technical paradigm [7]. In edge deployment scenarios, the research focus has shifted from purely pursuing accuracy to a comprehensive trade-off among accuracy, model size, inference latency, and energy consumption.
paragraphs.为适应资源受限设备，学界围绕轻量级网络设计、知识蒸馏、模型压缩与推理优化开展了大: To adapt to resource-constrained devices, the academic community has conducted extensive research on lightweight network design, knowledge distillation, model compression, and inference optimization [14]. Meanwhile, factors such as cross-age variation, pose deflection, occlusion, and backlight can significantly affect the stability of recognition features, so threshold calibration, sample quality control, continuous frame stabilization, and anti-repeat triggering mechanisms have become critical supplementary strategies in engineering implementation [6].
paragraphs.除识别精度外，边缘端人脸识别系统还需解决成员库增量更新、特征持久化、异常自恢复和: Beyond recognition accuracy, edge-side face recognition systems also need to address issues such as incremental updates of member databases, feature persistence, anomaly self-recovery, and operational observability. Especially in continuous video stream scenarios, the system typically needs to maintain long-term stable operation through throttling control, caching mechanisms, and log monitoring, which is also an important evaluation dimension for whether edge intelligence can actually be deployed [9].
paragraphs.物联网远程控制常见的实现方式包括轮询、长连接推送以及发布/订阅模型。相较于传统: Common implementation methods for IoT remote control include polling, long-connection push, and publish/subscribe models. Compared with traditional HTTP polling, the MQTT-based publish/subscribe mechanism is more suitable for device control scenarios in terms of message load, transmission latency, and scalability. Therefore, 'MQTT primary channel + HTTP polling fallback' has become a common engineering solution that balances low latency and high availability [12].
paragraphs.远程控制系统的核心不只是消息传输，还包括命令一致性、状态可观测性与执行可追溯性。: The core of a remote control system is not just message transmission, but also command consistency, state observability, and execution traceability. To avoid command loss, duplicate execution, or state inconsistency, engineering practices typically introduce command state machines, result reporting, and audit recording mechanisms to construct a closed-loop control chain from command creation, delivery, and execution to acknowledgment update [11][12].
paragraphs.在家庭安防场景中，远程开锁与抓拍属于高风险操作，系统必须同时满足低延迟响应和强安: In home security scenarios, remote unlocking and snapshot capture are high-risk operations, and the system must simultaneously satisfy low-latency response and strong security constraints. Therefore, related research generally emphasizes mechanisms such as identity authentication, device signatures, nonce anti-replay, least privilege control, and sensitive operation auditing to ensure the trustworthiness and accountability of the control link.
paragraphs.本课题以基于树莓派的智能门铃系统为研究对象，围绕家庭入口场景中的身份核验、访客留: This project takes the Raspberry Pi-based smart doorbell system as the research object and conducts system design around three core requirements in the home entrance scenario: identity verification, visitor trace recording, and remote handling. Combined with the requirements of home security for real-time performance, privacy, and weak-network availability, this paper adopts a system partitioning approach with collaboration among the device side, cloud, and mobile.
paragraphs.其中，设备端负责视频采集、人脸检测与识别、活体校验、门锁联动和本地缓存；云端负责: Specifically, the device side is responsible for video capture, face detection and recognition, liveness verification, door lock linkage, and local caching; the cloud is responsible for user authentication, device binding, member and visitor data management, command delivery, and result reporting; the mobile side is responsible for status display, history query, and high-risk operation interaction. The cloud provides a unified service interface through RESTful APIs and implements command and state management in combination with MySQL persistence and Redis caching.
paragraphs.全文结构安排如下：第1章为绪论；第2章分析系统可行性、功能需求与非功能需求；第3: The structure of this paper is arranged as follows: Chapter 1 is the introduction; Chapter 2 analyzes system feasibility, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements; Chapter 3 presents the overall design and business processes; Chapter 4 introduces the software design of the cloud service and Android client; Chapter 5 elaborates on the hardware solution and device-side software design; Chapter 6 describes system implementation and result analysis; Chapter 7 summarizes the full text and looks forward to future work.
paragraphs.从技术实现角度看，树莓派已具备运行轻量级视觉模型和物联网通信组件的基本能力，能够: From the perspective of technical implementation, the Raspberry Pi already possesses the basic capability to run lightweight visual models and IoT communication components, and can support tasks such as video capture, face detection, feature comparison, and remote control. To address the limited computing power and memory of edge devices, the system controls resource usage through mechanisms such as frame sampling, recognition throttling, and anomaly self-recovery, and makes engineering trade-offs among resolution, processing frequency, and recognition latency.
paragraphs.人脸数据属于敏感个人信息，系统设计需遵循最小必要、目的限定、明示告知与安全保护等: Face data is sensitive personal information, and the system design must follow principles such as minimum necessity, purpose limitation, explicit notification, and security protection. This paper moves recognition and liveness verification as far forward to the edge as possible, only uploading structured event records and necessary snapshot evidence to the cloud, thereby reducing the privacy exposure risk brought by centralized storage and large-scale transmission of raw face data [12].
paragraphs.系统硬件由树莓派、摄像头、蜂鸣器和步进电机/驱动板等通用器件构成，整体成本较低，: The system hardware consists of common components such as a Raspberry Pi, camera, buzzer, and stepper motor/driver board, with low overall cost and manageable procurement and maintenance difficulty. The software side adopts Python, Flask, MySQL, Redis, MQTT, and Android ecosystem components, with moderate development barriers and high reusability, suitable for graduation project verification and prototype system iteration [14].
paragraphs.随着家庭安防与智能家居需求持续增长，具备身份核验、事件留痕和远程处置能力的智能门: With the continuous growth of home security and smart home demands, smart doorbells with identity verification, event traceability, and remote handling capabilities have clear application value. In particular, edge-side local recognition and cloud-edge collaboration mechanisms balance privacy protection, low-latency response, and weak-network availability, aligning with the current trend of smart home systems evolving toward security, real-time capability, and trustworthiness [12].
paragraphs.设备端作为边缘执行单元，需要同时具备感知、决策、执行与留痕能力。具体而言，系统应: The device side, as the edge execution unit, needs to simultaneously possess sensing, decision-making, execution, and trace-recording capabilities. Specifically, the system should provide stable video capture, face detection and recognition, liveness detection, buzzer alerts, door lock linkage, stranger snapshot capture, local caching, and anomaly self-recovery functions, and support configuration of parameters such as resolution, frame capture frequency, recognition throttling, and cooldown windows to adapt to the short-stay and environmental fluctuation characteristics of the doorstep scenario [1][5].
paragraphs.云端需要将用户操作抽象为可投递、可追踪、可审计的控制命令。命令创建后应完成持久化: The cloud needs to abstract user operations into deliverable, trackable, and auditable control commands. After command creation, persistent storage should be completed, and the command should be delivered to the device through the MQTT primary channel or heartbeat polling fallback, with status and result fields written back after device execution, thereby forming a complete command closed loop and audit chain.
paragraphs.除远程控制外，云端还承担用户认证、家庭与设备绑定、在线状态维护、访客/告警记录持: Beyond remote control, the cloud also assumes responsibilities such as user authentication, family and device binding, online status maintenance, visitor/alarm record persistence, and mobile query support. Its core requirements are to ensure consistency of multi-terminal access, traceability, and controllable privilege escalation risk through permission boundaries, state synchronization, and structured data management.
paragraphs.Android 端是用户的主要交互入口，需要同时满足信息展示效率与高风险操作约束: The Android side is the user's main interaction portal, needing to simultaneously satisfy information display efficiency and high-risk operation constraints. Its basic capabilities include login/registration and session maintenance, a homepage statistical dashboard, device status viewing, visitor record review, member management, and photo upload. For high-risk operations such as remote unlocking, it should also provide clear interaction confirmation and result feedback mechanisms.
paragraphs.门禁放行属于典型的高风险授权场景，系统除用户侧鉴权与设备侧可信通信外，还需具备针: Access control admission is a typical high-risk authorization scenario. Beyond user-side authentication and device-side trusted communication, the system also needs detection capabilities against presentation attacks such as photo attacks, video replay, and screen recapture [4][15]. Therefore, this paper introduces liveness detection as a secondary verification after member recognition, and combines multi-frame capture, local motion cues, and conservative cloud recheck mechanisms to reduce the false admission probability, following a fail-close and low false admission priority security strategy [2][3].
paragraphs.系统在总体设计中遵循用户侧鉴权、设备侧可信通信与数据最小化处理的安全原则。用户访: The system follows the security principles of user-side authentication, device-side trusted communication, and data minimization in the overall design. Users need to carry a JWT Token when accessing cloud-protected resources, with the binding relationships among users, families, and devices serving as permission boundaries. Device-side requests use signature verification combined with nonce mechanisms to prevent replay attacks. Meanwhile, the system preferentially completes face recognition and liveness verification at the edge, only uploading necessary structured event data and snapshot evidence to the cloud, and performs desensitization processing on sensitive information, thereby balancing privacy protection, communication security, and audit traceability.
paragraphs.本系统采用设备端本地识别、云端集中管理与移动端远程控制的三端协同总体架构。设备端: This system adopts a three-end collaborative overall architecture of device-side local recognition, cloud centralized management, and mobile remote control. The device side is responsible for video capture, face detection and recognition, visitor recording, and local linkage.
paragraphs.系统首先采集视频帧并检测人脸区域，随后提取特征并进行身份判定。若识别为家庭成员，: The system first captures video frames and detects face regions, then extracts features and performs identity determination. If identified as a family member, it enters the local anti-photo detection and AI liveness recheck process; after passing liveness verification, it executes unlocking and records the family access event; if not passed, it blocks unlocking and records the liveness failure event. If the recognition result is not in the member database, it is determined as a stranger, and snapshot capture, visitor event recording, and monitoring triggering are executed. Various events are ultimately uploaded to the cloud or locally cached based on network status, thereby forming a complete recognition, handling, and synchronization closed loop.
paragraphs.当识别结果无法匹配到成员库时，系统判定为陌生访客并进行抓拍，生成包含时间、抓拍图: When the recognition result cannot be matched to the member database, the system determines the visitor as a stranger and captures a snapshot, generating a visitor record containing time, snapshot image, and recognition confidence information. If abnormal lingering of a stranger is detected or a blacklist rule is triggered, the alarm flow is initiated: buzzer warning, system lockout, and uploading of alarms and evidence for traceability.
paragraphs.设备端把访客记录经云端接口上传以后，由云端做持久化存储并自然、及时地更新统计数据: After the device side uploads visitor records through the cloud interface, the cloud performs persistent storage and timely updates statistical data. Abnormal events are recorded in alarm logs by the cloud, and data is actively and reliably provided to the mobile side through caching/messaging mechanisms. During network fluctuations, the device side first records data in local cache, then batch-resumes upload after network recovery, thus well ensuring data integrity.
paragraphs.移动端发起远程开锁、报警、语音或抓拍请求后，云端创建命令并写入命令队列，命令初始: After the mobile side initiates remote unlock, alarm, voice, or snapshot requests, the cloud creates a command and writes it to the command queue, with the command's initial state being pending. In the delivery phase, the command is preferentially pushed to the device-side subscribed topic via MQTT.
paragraphs.用户在 APP 端发起远程开锁请求后，云端首先完成身份校验、权限校验和设备在线状: After the user initiates a remote unlock request from the APP, the cloud first completes identity verification, permission verification, and device online status judgment. If verification fails or the device is offline, the request is directly rejected with a prompt message returned; if conditions are met, the cloud generates an unlock command and delivers it to the device side. After the device obtains the command, it executes the unlock operation and reports the execution result back to the cloud. Finally, the APP displays the processing result and generates an operation record, thereby forming a complete remote control command closed loop.
paragraphs.成员信息由移动端或管理端录入后保存至云端，设备端定期同步成员列表与人脸数据，并更: Member information is entered through the mobile or management side and saved to the cloud, and the device side periodically synchronizes the member list and face data, updating the local feature database.
paragraphs.设备端模块主要包括：摄像头采集模块、人脸识别模块、访客管理与本地持久化模块、交互: Device-side modules mainly include: camera capture module, face recognition module, visitor management and local persistence module, interaction and alarm module, data synchronization module, remote control execution module, and security protection module. Among these, face recognition and linkage handling are completed locally; data synchronization and remote control are responsible for interaction with the cloud, reducing module coupling.
paragraphs.云端模块主要包括：认证模块、家庭与成员管理模块、设备管理与心跳模块、访客与告警模: Cloud-side modules mainly include: authentication module, family and member management module, device management and heartbeat module, visitor and alarm module, remote command module, blacklist module, and file service module. The cloud provides services to the device and mobile sides through unified APIs, and ensures data consistency and access performance through database and caching components.
paragraphs.Android 端模块包括：登录注册模块、首页看板模块、访客模块、成员模块、设置: Android-side modules include: login/registration module, homepage dashboard module, visitor module, member module, settings module, and remote control module. The client adopts MVVM + Repository for layering, network access is uniformly encapsulated by Retrofit, and Tokens are persisted using secure storage components.
paragraphs.为明确智能门铃与访客管理系统在用户端、云端与设备端之间的功能分工，并梳理主要业务: To clarify the functional division of the smart doorbell and visitor management system among the user side, cloud, and device side, and to organize the module relationships of main business capabilities, this paper presents an overall division of system functional modules, as shown in Figure 3.5.
paragraphs.为说明系统在成员识别、陌生访客处置、活体校验和数据同步中的处理逻辑，本文给出如图: To illustrate the system's processing logic in member recognition, stranger handling, liveness verification, and data synchronization, this paper presents the face recognition and event processing flow diagram as shown in Figure 3.2.
paragraphs.为说明远程控制请求在移动端、云端与设备端之间的传递关系，本文以远程开锁为例，对命: To illustrate the transmission relationship of remote control requests among the mobile, cloud, and device sides, this paper takes remote unlocking as an example and outlines the processing from command initiation, verification, delivery to execution reporting, as shown in Figure 3.4.
paragraphs.本章从云端服务与Android客户端两部分展开软件实现设计，重点说明数据模型、接: This chapter elaborates on the software implementation design from the two parts of cloud service and Android client, focusing on data models, interface boundaries, communication links, and security mechanisms, and provides key module implementation points.
paragraphs.联调阶段最容易出问题的是移动端接口字段、云端返回结构与设备端上报字段三者不一致，: During the integration phase, the most common problems are inconsistencies among mobile interface fields, cloud return structures, and device-side reporting fields. Therefore, this project has made appropriate designs on the cloud side: a unified response encapsulation format, clearly defined error code conventions, retention of necessary request information in logs while desensitizing sensitive fields, making problems traceable, reproducible, and easier to fix.
paragraphs.在实际实现时云端用Flask来构建RESTful API,把路由按认证、设备、访: In actual implementation, the cloud side uses Flask to build RESTful APIs, dividing routes by functions such as authentication, devices, visitors/alarms, members/blacklists, and remote control. Correspondingly, MySQL is used to persist core business data including visitors, alarms, commands, and device status; Redis is used for nonce verification and lightweight caching; MQTT is specifically responsible for low-latency command push; resources such as snapshots and member photos are stored in file directories, with each interface returning their accessible paths for mobile invocation.
paragraphs.云端部分的定位很明确：把设备端上报的数据“收下来、存起来、查得出来”，同时把移动: The positioning of the cloud side is very clear: 'receive, store, and query' the data reported by the device side, while translating mobile operations into commands, delivering them to devices, and finally obtaining and recording receipts. Therefore, the cloud is not simply a stack of interfaces but is organized around data management, command closed loops, and permission boundaries.
paragraphs.在逻辑表设计层面，各数据表围绕“用户-家庭-设备-成员-事件-命令”闭环组织。下: At the logical table design level, each data table is organized around the 'user-family-device-member-event-command' closed loop. The key data tables are described below by main business objects.
paragraphs.用户表用于保存移动端注册用户的账号凭证和基础联系方式，是登录认证、JWT 签发与: The User Table is used to save account credentials and basic contact information of registered mobile users, serving as the basis for login authentication, JWT issuance, and permission boundary determination. The User Table structure is shown in Table 4.1.
paragraphs.家庭表用于维护家庭实体及其所有者信息，为设备归属、成员管理和访客记录建立统一的业: The Family Table is used to maintain family entities and their owner information, establishing a unified business scope for device ownership, member management, and visitor records. The Family Table structure is shown in Table 4.2.
paragraphs.家庭成员关系表用于维护用户与家庭的加入关系，支撑多用户共享设备、家庭协同管理等业: The Family Member Relationship Table is used to maintain the join relationships between users and families, supporting business scenarios such as multi-user device sharing and collaborative family management. The Family Member Relationship Table structure is shown in Table 4.3.
paragraphs.成员资料表用于保存被识别对象的姓名和人脸照片元数据，是设备端同步成员库和执行人脸: The Member Profile Table is used to save the names and face photo metadata of recognized subjects, serving as an important data source for device-side member database synchronization and face matching. The Member Profile Table structure is shown in Table 4.4.
paragraphs.设备表用于保存门铃设备的唯一标识、在线状态、固件版本和鉴权令牌，是设备注册、心跳: The Device Table is used to save the unique identifier, online status, firmware version, and authentication token of doorbell devices, serving as the core table for device registration, heartbeat reporting, and command delivery. The Device Table structure is shown in Table 4.5.
paragraphs.访客记录表用于保存家庭成员识别与陌生访客抓拍结果，包括识别类型、置信度和图片路径: The Visitor Record Table is used to save family member recognition and stranger snapshot capture results, including information such as recognition type, confidence, and image paths, serving as the data foundation for mobile visitor viewing and statistical analysis. The Visitor Record Table structure is shown in Table 4.6.
paragraphs.访问日志表用于记录开锁动作及其触发来源，可区分人脸开锁、远程开锁等操作，是审计追: The Access Log Table is used to record unlock actions and their trigger sources, distinguishing between face unlock, remote unlock, and other operations, serving as an important basis for audit tracking and behavior statistics. The Access Log Table structure is shown in Table 4.7.
paragraphs.报警记录表用于保存异常访客或安全事件触发后的原因、时长与处理状态，便于后续告警回: The Alarm Record Table is used to save the cause, duration, and processing status after abnormal visitor or security event triggering, facilitating subsequent alarm review and manual handling. The Alarm Record Table structure is shown in Table 4.8.
paragraphs.远程命令表用于记录云端下发到设备端的控制指令及其状态流转，形成 pending、: The Remote Command Table is used to record control instructions delivered from the cloud to the device side and their state transitions, forming a closed-loop tracking mechanism of pending, delivered, executed, and failed. The Remote Command Table structure is shown in Table 4.9.
paragraphs.上述表共同支撑了用户鉴权、成员管理、识别上报、告警处置和远程控制等核心业务，为系: The above tables jointly support core business operations such as user authentication, member management, recognition reporting, alarm handling, and remote control, providing a unified data foundation for three-end system collaboration and data traceability.
paragraphs.统计类接口本质上是为按天聚合与分类计数设计的，故要按visitor_type拆分: Statistical interfaces are essentially designed for daily aggregation and category counting, so visitor counts need to be split by visitor_type into family members and strangers, and TOP statistics of alarm causes are also needed. Engineering-wise, it is reasonable to avoid pushing all statistical computation to the client: the mobile side only displays aggregated results, thus reducing client burden while maintaining data consistency.
paragraphs.由于访客记录、告警记录都是移动端访问最频繁的数据，所以列表要进行分页处理，详情宜: Since visitor records and alarm records are the most frequently accessed data on the mobile side, lists should be paginated, details should be traceable, and the homepage should have statistics. Furthermore, since the most commonly used filter conditions for user queries are device_id, created_at (time window), and handled (processing status), indexes need to be established on these fields to support pagination and time-range queries.
paragraphs.认证模块有用户注册、登录、Token刷新及用户信息查询等接口，当移动端登录成功以: The authentication module has interfaces for user registration, login, token refresh, and user information query. After the mobile side successfully logs in, it obtains a JWT Token, and subsequent access to protected resources requires carrying the Authorization header in HTTP requests. Therefore, interface design should naturally consider issues such as unified error codes and prompts, password security processing, token lifecycle management, and permission boundary constraints.
paragraphs.本设计把推送不稳定从不可控风险变成了可解释、可控制的状态。当MQTT断开之后，设: This design transforms push instability from an uncontrollable risk into an explainable and controllable state. When MQTT disconnects, the device will pull pending commands for continued execution on the next heartbeat, which raises another issue: the polling interval is not better when smaller, as an overly short interval increases server burden and device-side network overhead. Therefore, the combination of 'MQTT primary channel + HTTP polling' was ultimately adopted, with parameters reasonably adjusted according to the actual network environment during deployment, prioritizing overall stability.
paragraphs.设备管理接口的根本问题不是能不能访问，而是能不能长期稳定的运行，因此设备端启动以: The fundamental issue of device management interfaces is not whether they can be accessed, but whether they can operate stably over the long term. Therefore, after the device side starts up, it first completes registration and identity authentication, then reports heartbeats at fixed intervals to declare online status. Thus, the heartbeat interface designed in this project serves an engineering purpose: when the MQTT push link is abnormal, it can return a list of pending commands as a fallback channel.
paragraphs.访客模块有访客上传、列表分页、详情查询、统计等接口，设备端识别访客之后即把访客记: The visitor module has interfaces for visitor upload, paginated lists, detail queries, and statistics. After the device side recognizes a visitor, it uploads the visitor record to the cloud for storage, which is then provided to the mobile side for review. Whenever the visitor_type is stranger or abnormal logic is triggered, the cloud will timely and reliably write alarm events to alarm_logs. Therefore, the alarm module naturally provides alarm list and handling interfaces, allowing users to confirm, annotate, and mark abnormal events as processed, thereby naturally forming a complete and manageable security event chain.
paragraphs.成员模块提供成员列表、添加、删除与更新接口，并支持成员照片上传，用于设备端特征库: The member module provides interfaces for member listing, adding, deleting, and updating, and supports member photo upload for building and updating the device-side feature database. The blacklist module provides interfaces for blacklist entry management, device-side synchronization, and hit reporting.
paragraphs.(5) 远程控制接口与命令闭环: (5) Remote Control Interfaces and Command Closed Loop
paragraphs.云端在接口设计中对命令类型做了枚举约束，并且对高风险操作做更严格的权限校验，自然: In interface design, the cloud imposes enumeration constraints on command types and performs stricter permission verification for high-risk operations, which naturally helps restrict users to only operate their bound devices.
paragraphs.设备端执行完毕以后把结果（成功/失败、错误原因、有关证据路径等）及时、可靠地回传: After the device side completes execution, it timely and reliably reports the results (success/failure, error reasons, relevant evidence paths, etc.) back to the cloud. Therefore, the cloud can promptly update the command status and timestamp fields, enabling the system to clearly distinguish between commands not delivered, commands delivered but not executed, execution failures, and other situations, which also facilitates the formation of standardized audit records.
paragraphs.远程控制是用户感知最明显也是风险最高的功能，故本项目对远程控制作了有层次的设计：: Remote control is the most perceptible and highest-risk function for users, so this project has made a layered design for remote control: completely avoiding the uncontrollable factor of direct execution upon button press, i.e., first having the mobile side initiate a request, then having the cloud create a command record and persist it, and only then transmitting the command to the device side for execution through the communication channel.
paragraphs.除远程控制外，云端新增活体检测接口 POST /api/liveness/che: In addition to remote control, the cloud has added a liveness detection interface POST /api/liveness/check for device-side invocation. The interface receives device_id, member_name, and multi-frame images and returns fields such as live/score/reason/provider.
paragraphs.(1) 用户侧 JWT 校验与权限边界: (1) User-Side JWT Verification and Permission Boundaries
paragraphs.用户侧用JWT实现无状态鉴权，云端对各受保护接口中所携带的Token都作有效性校: The user side uses JWT for stateless authentication. The cloud verifies the validity of tokens carried in each protected interface, reasonably uses the binding relationships among users, families, and devices to restrict resource access scope, and for high-risk interfaces such as remote unlocking, should also add device ownership verification.
paragraphs.设备侧通信引入了签名鉴权，云端可以根据设备标识、共享密钥来校验请求的合法性，而设: Device-side communication introduces signature authentication. The cloud can verify the legitimacy of requests based on device identifiers and shared keys, while device requests also carry a nonce. The cloud writes the nonce to Redis with an appropriate expiration time, and any duplicate nonce found is treated as a replay and directly rejected. This greatly improves device communication security without adopting a complex certificate system.
paragraphs.本项目在部署、联调阶段更关心的问题是连接是否稳定、消息是否会丢、状态是否能回传，: During the deployment and integration phases, this project is more concerned with whether the connection is stable, whether messages will be lost, and whether status can be reported back. Therefore, it does not target a fixed latency value, but rather uses the heartbeat fallback channel to ensure reachability when the push link fluctuates, thereby containing system risks.
paragraphs.MQTT推送通道有利于实现快速命令投递，因此云端把命令发布到按设备维度划分的主题: The MQTT push channel facilitates fast command delivery, so the cloud publishes commands to topics divided by device dimension, and the device side can receive commands by maintaining a subscription to the topic. The advantages of this approach in home network environments are low bandwidth usage and friendly interaction latency, but it must also handle engineering details such as reconnection, subscription recovery, and abnormal disconnection.
paragraphs.在项目调试中，启用 MQTT 作为主通道后，命令投递延迟相较单纯轮询有明显改善；: In project debugging, after enabling MQTT as the primary channel, command delivery latency has significantly improved compared to pure polling; meanwhile, retaining the heartbeat interface to pull pending commands as a fallback allows continued delivery and status updates during short-term network instability.
paragraphs.(3) 命令状态流转与结果回传: (3) Command State Transition and Result Reporting
paragraphs.由联调经验可知：绝大多数问题不是功能没实现，而是链路某一步卡住了。具体而言，命令: From integration experience, the vast majority of problems are not unimplemented functions but a certain step in the chain getting stuck. Specifically, a command staying at pending indicates it has not been delivered; entering delivered but not executed is generally due to device-side execution failure or acknowledgment reporting failure. Therefore, using status fields and timestamps to locate problems is more direct and convenient, and also helps the mobile side provide clear prompts.
paragraphs.命令状态机把远程控制从一次性请求变成了可追踪的过程，因此云端对每条命令都维护st: The command state machine transforms remote control from a one-time request into a traceable process. Therefore, the cloud maintains a status field for each command, while recording important time points such as created_at, delivered_at, and executed_at. After the device side reports the result and failure cause, the cloud updates the status and saves the result.
paragraphs.系统中有成员照片、访客抓拍等资源文件，因此云端用上传接口把文件上传到指定目录，再: The system has resource files such as member photos and visitor snapshots, so the cloud uses upload interfaces to upload files to designated directories and then provides corresponding resource URLs to the mobile side. For this purpose, during engineering deployment, upload types and file sizes should be reasonably restricted, path formats should be standardized, security vulnerabilities such as directory traversal should be eliminated, and finally, combined with access control policies, resources should only be open to authorized users.
paragraphs.毕业设计阶段需要快速迭代，所以使用的结构应该更利于接口变更：接口变更时只需在Ap: The graduation project phase requires rapid iteration, so the structure used should better facilitate interface changes: when interfaces change, only modifications are needed at the ApiService/Repository layer, with minimal changes to the page portion, making integration debugging very convenient.
paragraphs.在实现时采用了分层组织的方式来降低耦合：UI层做界面显示及交互处理，Reposi: In implementation, a layered organization approach was adopted to reduce coupling: the UI layer handles interface display and interaction processing, the Repository serves as the business entry point uniformly encapsulating interface calls and data conversion, the network layer uses Retrofit+OkHttp to handle requests and interceptor logic, and local storage is used to save tokens and necessary user information.
paragraphs.移动端的目标很直接：由于要让用户看得见门口发生了什么，又要有能远程处置的功能，故: The goal of the mobile side is very direct: since users need to see what is happening at the door and have remote handling capabilities, the client pages are designed around three high-frequency tasks: visitor record review, member management, and remote control.
paragraphs.联调阶段，最常见的问题是鉴权失败与字段不一致：例如 Token 过期导致 401: During the integration phase, the most common problems are authentication failures and field inconsistencies: for example, token expiration causing 401 errors, or server-side field name adjustments causing parsing failures. Therefore, in addition to basic logging, the network layer needs to pass error codes and messages to the upper layer, use Toast/dialog prompts to inform users, and guide re-login when necessary. This kind of 'explainable error' experience often enhances user trust in the system more than simply pursuing request success rates.
paragraphs.客户端网络层将云端接口集中定义在 ApiService 中，避免在各个页面里散落: The client network layer centrally defines cloud interfaces in ApiService, avoiding scattered URL and request header assembly code across pages. Retrofit is responsible for converting interface definitions into callable methods, while OkHttp uniformly handles token appending, log output, and timeout policies through interceptors.
paragraphs.客户端用数据模型类来承载云端返回的各种结构如登录响应、访客记录、统计信息等，并使: The client uses data model classes to carry various structures returned by the cloud, such as login responses, visitor records, and statistical information, and uses Gson for field mapping. The client also makes corresponding error handling for network exceptions, server exceptions, and authentication failures: user-perceivable errors are prompted via Toast or dialogs with appropriate re-login guidance, while development debugging errors are accompanied by log output and interface return information, greatly facilitating problem localization.
paragraphs.Repository 层对认证、访客、成员与远程控制等业务进行封装，屏蔽底层接口: The Repository layer encapsulates business operations such as authentication, visitors, members, and remote control, shielding underlying interface details. For example, after successful login, the Repository is responsible for saving Tokens and maintaining sessions; visitor list interfaces are handled by the Repository for pagination parameters and data conversion; remote control interfaces are uniformly encapsulated by the Repository for command types and request payloads, reducing maintenance costs caused by scattered business logic in the UI layer.
paragraphs.Repository层对认证、访客、成员、远程控制诸类业务作了很好的封装，因此能: The Repository layer provides good encapsulation for authentication, visitor, member, and remote control businesses, thus shielding underlying interface details: after successful login, the Repository saves Tokens and manages sessions; visitor list interfaces are handled by the Repository for pagination parameters and data conversion; remote control interfaces are uniformly encapsulated by the Repository for command types and request payloads, thereby reducing maintenance costs caused by scattered UI-layer business logic.
paragraphs.客户端有登录、注册两个界面，当用户输入账号密码后进行认证，登录成功就进入主界面，: The client has two interfaces: login and registration. When users enter their account and password for authentication, successful login enters the main interface, while authentication failure displays an error prompt and allows users to retry. The purpose of registration is to create a new user and complete basic information initialization, thereby naturally leading to subsequent family and device binding.
paragraphs.从图4. 1和图4. 2可以很清楚、自然地看到登录及注册界面，客户端在提交认证请: From Figure 4.1 and Figure 4.2, the login and registration interfaces can be clearly and naturally seen. The client checks input completeness before submitting the authentication request. After successful login, it enters the main interface, while the registration process is used to create new users and initialize basic information, also preparing for subsequent family and device binding.
paragraphs.为避免 Token 明文存储带来的泄露风险，客户端使用 EncryptedSha: To avoid the leakage risk of plaintext Token storage, the client uses EncryptedSharedPreferences to save Tokens and necessary user information. When the application starts, it first reads the local Token: if it exists and is valid, it enters the main interface; otherwise, it redirects to the login page. This mechanism reduces the cost of repeated logins while forming a complete session closed loop with cloud JWT authentication.
paragraphs.主界面采用 BottomNavigation 实现模块入口切换，主要包含：首页（: The main interface uses BottomNavigation to switch between module entries, mainly including: Homepage (statistics and remote control), Visitors, Members, Settings, and other modules. The implementation uses Fragment containers with FragmentTransaction for page switching, characterized by intuitive structure and easy debugging. Menu resources correspond one-to-one with page modules, facilitating subsequent expansion of more functional entries.

runs.设备端以视频流为输入，用dlib（face_recognition）来做人脸检测: The device side takes video streams as input, uses dlib (face_recognition) for face detection and feature extraction, then performs distance comparison against the local member feature database. When a member is identified, it triggers a buzzer alert and door lock linkage (simulated by stepper motor), while using an action cooldown window to prevent repeated triggering. When a stranger is identified, it automatically captures a snapshot for traceability, and activates alarm/lockdown procedures based on blacklist policies as needed. The cloud side uses the Flask RESTful API
runs.在数据流设计上，设备端所采集的结构化事件如访客类型、时间、相似度、抓拍图片路径等: In terms of data flow design, structured events collected by the device side, such as visitor type, time, similarity, and snapshot image paths, are first uploaded to the cloud via API. While the cloud persists the storage, it simultaneously exposes two types of interfaces—paginated queries and statistical analysis—to the mobile side. Remote control is initiated by the mobile side, with commands generated by the cloud and reliably and timely delivered to the device side via MQTT/heartbeat channels for execution. Finally, the device side reports the execution results to the cloud. This design fully embodies the concept of edge computing and cloud management.
runs.设备端是系统实时性与可用性的关键，因此本项采用了模块化设计，把视频采集、人脸识别: The device side is critical to the system's real-time performance and availability, so this project adopts a modular design, decoupling functions such as video capture, face recognition, visitor management, interaction and alarm, data synchronization, remote control execution, and security protection into independent modules, which are then uniformly orchestrated by the main program. The main loop uses frame capture, recognition-handling-reporting-command receiving-execution return as the basic closed loop to appropriately handle two types of scenarios: local admission and abnormal alarms.
runs.安全性需求进一步包括：一是移动端访问需进行 Token 校验与权限控制；二是设备: Security requirements further include: first, mobile access requires token verification and permission control; second, device communication needs to incorporate signature and nonce mechanisms to suppress forgery and replay risks; third, structured auditing of high-risk events such as remote unlocking, liveness detection failure, and abnormal access is required to support post-event tracking and accountability.
runs.可靠性需求包括三个方面：一是网络波动条件下的业务连续性，即支持本地缓存、断网续传: Reliability requirements include three aspects: first, business continuity under network fluctuation conditions, i.e., supporting local caching, offline resumable transmission, and push-plus-polling dual-channel fallback; second, long-term device-side operational reliability, i.e., reducing the probability of freezing and unresponsiveness through single-instance constraints, resource contention isolation, and frame-capture-failure self-recovery mechanisms; third, full-link anomaly handling capability, i.e., both the cloud and device sides need to provide clear error states, retry strategies, and log output.

runs.移动端远程控制的三端协同总体架构。设备端负责视频采集、人脸检测与识别、访客记录与: mobile remote control. The device side is responsible for video capture, face detection and recognition, visitor recording, and local linkage;
runs.访客列表是移动端最常用的回看入口。列表项通常只展示最关键的信息：抓拍缩略图、访客: The visitor list is the most commonly used review entry on the mobile side. List items typically display only the most critical information: snapshot thumbnails, visitor type, time, and brief title, with clicking entering the detail page to view complete fields.

cells.智能门铃：嵌入式端人脸识别与访客管理系统: Smart Doorbell: Embedded Face Recognition and Visitor Management System
cells.访客记录 ID，自增主键: Visitor record ID, auto-increment primary key
cells.访问日志 ID，自增主键: Access log ID, auto-increment primary key
cells.报警记录 ID，自增主键: Alarm record ID, auto-increment primary key
cells.降低CPU占用与温升，避免重复计算；在画面快速变化时仍保持可用响应。: Reduce CPU usage and temperature rise, avoid duplicate computation; maintain usable response during rapid scene changes.
cells.阈值越低越严格，可降低误识别；结合现场光照与摄像头位置调优。: Lower threshold is stricter, reducing false recognition; optimized according to on-site lighting and camera position.
cells.同一成员≥5s 才允许再次开锁: Same member ≥5s before allowing another unlock
cells.避免同一人短时间内多次识别触发导致重复开锁与机械磨损。: Avoid repeated unlocking and mechanical wear caused by multiple recognition triggers of the same person in a short time.
cells.连续取帧失败后重置摄像头: Reset camera after consecutive frame capture failures
cells.摄像头异常占用/断连时自动重建采集对象，提升长期运行稳定性。: Automatically rebuild capture object when camera is abnormally occupied/disconnected, improving long-term operation stability.
cells.选择云端活体判定策略；先启发式统计，再由通义千问做保守复核。: Select cloud liveness determination strategy; first heuristic statistics, then conservative recheck by Tongyi Qianwen.
cells.每次判定采集的帧数；帧数不足则认为结果不可信，避免误放行。: Number of frames collected per determination; insufficient frames make results untrustworthy, avoiding false admission.
cells.拉长多帧覆盖窗口，提升捕捉微动作的概率。: Extend the multi-frame coverage window to increase the probability of capturing micro-movements.
cells.活体通过的最低分数阈值，可结合样本逐步调优。: Minimum score threshold for liveness pass, can be gradually tuned with samples.
cells.同一次识别允许二次复核投票，降低真人偶发误拒。: Same recognition allows secondary recheck voting, reducing occasional false rejection of real persons.
cells.分数很高时直接放行，减少不必要的二次复核开销。: Directly admit when score is very high, reducing unnecessary secondary recheck overhead.
cells.设备端本地反照片启发式（帧差/残差）作为前置筛查，提高鲁棒性。: Device-side local anti-photo heuristic (frame difference/residual) as pre-screening, improving robustness.
cells.默认 fail-close：活体未通过不放行，适用于门禁场景“低误放行优先”。: Default fail-close: no admission without liveness pass, suitable for access control 'low false admission priority' scenarios.
